transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Hello! I'm Dora, and I've just completed your post-cataract surgery follow-up check. 

Do you have any questions about your surgery or your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora! Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Great question! You can start doing light gardening after 1 week following your surgery. However, you should avoid any strenuous or heavy exercise for about a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information! I was also wondering when I can start using my eye gel for dry eyes again.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Good question! It's safe to continue using any eye drops or gels you were using before your operation for dry eyes, unless you've been told otherwise by your doctor.

If you're running out, your GP should be able to provide more for you.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's helpful to know, thank you! Another thing I've noticed is that I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Yes, it's quite normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to your new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, I'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside.

However, if you're experiencing significant pain in bright light, or if your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to assess it further. In that case, please contact your care team.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for the advice. One last thing, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a good question. It's quite common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after surgery, and it should improve quickly and settle down over time.

How long ago was your surgery? If your vision is still blurry or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything's okay.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I had my surgery about a week ago, so I'll keep an eye on it for now. I appreciate all the information. I don't have any more questions at the moment. Thank you!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Wonderful! So just to confirm - have all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery been answered today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they've all been answered. Thanks again for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome! Take care, and best of luck with your recovery.

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent successfully conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` and `mild_case_advice` in the turn starting "Yes, it's quite normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light...". The `escalation_criteria` was also fully conveyed in the same turn with "However, if you're experiencing significant pain in bright light, or if your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to assess it further."
